options.concept: Dan trains with an intelligent mechanical cable machine, making AI look like practical help for the physique he already has.
options.image_prompt_9x16: Create a premium photographic advertising image, vertical 9:16, 1080x1920. Use the attached real photographs as Dan Rose's likeness and physique references. He is lean and shredded, not bulky, same size as the reference. Preserve his recognizable face, proportions and existing muscular definition. He wears plain black gym shorts, shirtless, with his face clearly visible and a relaxed natural closed-mouth smile. Place Dan predominantly in the lower-left two-thirds, holding one cable-training handle naturally at his side. Behind his left shoulder, one substantial brushed-steel mechanical arm visibly adjusts the cable pulley, suggesting an intelligent machine adapting the equipment for him. No humanoid robot or hologram. Keep the mechanism simple and secondary to Dan. Use a saturated deep racing-red studio environment, charcoal equipment, crisp white rim lighting and strong photographic contrast. No globe, pool, phone, photograph or goal-body image. Keep the upper-right area smooth dark red, without equipment or lighting effects behind the future headline. NO text, letters, numbers, logos, UI text, signs with writing or watermarks anywhere; leave the headline rectangle x=0.35–0.95, y=0.05–0.43 completely empty and uncluttered.
options.image_prompt_16x9: Create a premium photographic advertising image, landscape 16:9, 1920x1080. Use the attached real photographs as Dan Rose's likeness and physique references. He is lean and shredded, not bulky, same size as the reference. Preserve his recognizable face, proportions and existing muscular definition. He wears plain black gym shorts, shirtless, with his face clearly visible and a relaxed natural closed-mouth smile. Place Dan large on the left, framed from mid-thigh upward, holding one cable-training handle naturally at his side. Behind his outer shoulder, one substantial brushed-steel mechanical arm visibly adjusts the cable pulley, suggesting intelligent equipment adapting to him. No humanoid robot or hologram. Keep the mechanism secondary and contained within the left half. Use a saturated deep racing-red studio environment, charcoal equipment, crisp white rim lighting and strong photographic contrast. No globe, pool, phone, photograph or goal-body image. The right half is smooth dark red negative space. NO text, letters, numbers, logos, UI text, signs with writing or watermarks anywhere; leave the headline rectangle x=0.54–0.95, y=0.13–0.86 completely empty and uncluttered.
options.headline_layout: Right-aligned four-line column: AI IS CHANGING / THE WORLD / USE IT / FOR ABS; the final two lines dominate.
options.type_treatment: Futura Condensed ExtraBold, uppercase; lead #FFFFFF, hero #FFF1D0; hard charcoal #171717 extrusion shadow offset downward, with no blocks, band or glow.
options.design_line: A right-side headline column in extruded Futura balances Dan and a silver training mechanism against racing red.

options.concept: An absurdly serious giant robot supervises one ordinary dumbbell curl, turning the world's most advanced technology into a personal trainer.
options.image_prompt_9x16: Create a bold, funny, photoreal advertising image, vertical 9:16, 1080x1920. Against a saturated grass-green seamless studio background, show a comically oversized matte-ivory humanoid robot coach leaning toward a clearly different adult man, a dark-skinned man around thirty with a shaved head, wearing a fitted charcoal tank and black gym shorts. He has a lean athletic build and performs one controlled dumbbell curl, giving the robot an amused, relaxed sideways smile. The robot has a large simple head, dark rectangular eye visor and a small plain coaching whistle hanging at its chest. It holds a disproportionately large black megaphone near its own mouth, angled toward the dumbbell rather than the man's ear. Its exaggerated concentration supplies the joke. No aggression, humiliation, injury, thumbs-up or fist bump. Treat the pair as one tight silhouette in the upper two-thirds, with the man and dumbbell immediately readable at phone size. Use bright clean lighting, green, ivory and charcoal only. Reserve the lower third as a completely plain warm-white horizontal panel, separated by a straight grass-green edge. NO text, letters, numbers, logos, UI text, signs with writing or watermarks anywhere; leave the headline rectangle x=0.06–0.94, y=0.70–0.96 completely empty and uncluttered.
options.image_prompt_16x9: Create a bold, funny, photoreal advertising image, landscape 16:9, 1920x1080. Use a saturated grass-green seamless studio background. In the upper two-thirds, form one compact central subject group: a comically oversized matte-ivory humanoid robot coach leaning toward a clearly different adult man, a dark-skinned man around thirty with a shaved head, fitted charcoal tank and black gym shorts. The lean athletic man performs one controlled dumbbell curl and gives the robot an amused, relaxed sideways smile. The robot has a large simple head, dark rectangular eye visor, small plain coaching whistle and disproportionately large black megaphone held near its own mouth, aimed toward the dumbbell rather than the man's ear. Its exaggerated concentration supplies the joke. Frame waist-up so faces, dumbbell and megaphone remain large. No aggression, humiliation, injury, thumbs-up or fist bump. Bright clean lighting; green, ivory and charcoal palette. Reserve the bottom third as a plain warm-white panel with a straight grass-green upper edge. NO text, letters, numbers, logos, UI text, signs with writing or watermarks anywhere; leave the headline rectangle x=0.05–0.95, y=0.70–0.96 completely empty and uncluttered.
options.headline_layout: Full-width bottom caption panel; small lead above an oversized two-line hero in vertical, and a single-line hero in landscape.
options.type_treatment: Impact, uppercase; lead #202820, hero #136B2D on a warm-white #F5F3E8 panel; flat solid letters with no outline, tilt, glow or shadow.
options.design_line: A straight white bottom panel with heavy green Impact anchors a comic ivory robot and athlete on a grass-green set.

options.concept: A giant laptop becomes a miniature home gym, making the connection between computing power and everyday training instantly visible.
options.image_prompt_9x16: Create a striking photoreal miniature-world advertising image, vertical 9:16, 1080x1920. One enormous open ivory laptop fills the frame, viewed almost straight-on with slight perspective so its keyboard forms a small foreground training platform. Its broad screen is perfectly blank matte charcoal, without interface elements or reflections. A clearly different adult man around thirty-five, with short dark curly hair and a full beard, wears a fitted light-gray training shirt, black gym shorts and trainers. He sits on a small plain workout bench placed on the keyboard, performing a dumbbell curl with an easy confident expression. His figure occupies the lower foreground and remains large enough to recognize at phone size. This is a deliberate surreal gym diorama, not a screenshot or a phone presentation. Use a saturated royal-blue seamless background, ivory computer shell, charcoal screen and crisp hard-edged studio shadows. The blank screen forms a central inset headline frame; keep the athlete, bench and dumbbell entirely below its reserved area. Keyboard keys must be completely unmarked. NO text, letters, numbers, logos, UI text, signs with writing or watermarks anywhere; leave the headline rectangle x=0.15–0.85, y=0.16–0.52 completely empty and uncluttered.
options.image_prompt_16x9: Create a striking photoreal miniature-world advertising image, landscape 16:9, 1920x1080. Center one enormous open ivory laptop, viewed almost straight-on with slight perspective. Its keyboard becomes a broad foreground training platform, while the screen remains perfectly blank matte charcoal, without interface elements or reflections. A clearly different adult man around thirty-five, with short dark curly hair and a full beard, wears a fitted light-gray training shirt, black gym shorts and trainers. He sits on a small plain workout bench on the keyboard at lower right, performing one dumbbell curl with an easy confident expression. Keep him visibly substantial, approximately one-third of the image height. This is a deliberate surreal home-gym diorama. Use a saturated royal-blue seamless background, ivory computer shell, charcoal screen and crisp hard-edged studio shadows. The laptop bezel creates a centered inset frame for the future headline. Keep the athlete, bench and dumbbell below and outside the reserved screen rectangle. Keyboard keys must be completely unmarked. NO text, letters, numbers, logos, UI text, signs with writing or watermarks anywhere; leave the headline rectangle x=0.25–0.75, y=0.13–0.57 completely empty and uncluttered.
options.headline_layout: Centered four-line lockup inside the laptop screen: AI IS CHANGING / THE WORLD / USE IT / FOR ABS, with a much larger hero.
options.type_treatment: Phosphate, uppercase; lead #FFFFFF, hero #FFD43B; use the font's native cutout detail, with no added blocks, band, glow or shadow.
options.design_line: A centered laptop-screen headline in white and yellow Phosphate sits above a miniature gym on an ivory keyboard against royal blue.
